WYD_SOUTH.desc: An easy day on Wayanad's water: the ghat view from Lakkidi, a forest lake at Pookode, Karlad's quiet lake and India's largest earth dam at Banasura Sagar.
WYD_SOUTH.itin:
7:30 AM — Pickup: Kalpetta KSRTC bus station · Sulthan Bathery bus station · your resort on the way (Bathery 7:30 · Kalpetta 8:15)
8:45 AM — Lakkidi viewpoint & Chain Tree: The view down the Thamarassery ghat, and the legend of the chained tree. (Photo stop)
9:30 AM — Pookode Lake: A freshwater lake ringed by evergreen forest, with pedal boats. (Entry & boating own expense)
11:45 AM — Karlad Lake: A quiet lake below the hills; kayaks and a zipline for the brave. Lunch nearby, own expense. (Activities paid direct)
2:00 PM — Banasura Sagar Dam: India's largest earth dam, with islands in the reservoir and the Banasura hills behind. (Entry & speedboat own expense)
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Kalpetta, Sulthan Bathery, or your resort
WYD_SOUTH.gtk:
🌧️ Rain & closures: Boating and adventure stop in heavy rain or wind; red-alert days can close the lakes and dam. We check the evening before and call you if plans change.
🚶 Walking: Banasura is an uphill walk from the car park; buggies may run, own expense. Pookode and Karlad paths are easy but can be slippery.
🎟️ Tickets: Entry, boating, kayak and zipline are paid at each counter. Carry cash and UPI; weekend queues are long at Banasura.
🗓️ Staying longer?: Edakkal, Thirunelli and Muthanga are our other Wayanad day tours. Combine two for a full Wayanad weekend.
WYD_SOUTH.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
WYD_SOUTH.exc: Lunch; Lake, dam, boating and adventure fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
WYD_SOUTH.carry: Light jacket or raincoat; Walking shoes; Hat and sunscreen; Cash / UPI for entry fees

WYD_NORTH.desc: North Wayanad in a day: the ancient Thirunelli temple below Brahmagiri, a bamboo-raft crossing to Kuruva's river islands and an afternoon jeep safari at Tholpetty.
WYD_NORTH.itin:
6:00 AM — Pickup: Kalpetta KSRTC bus station · Sulthan Bathery bus station · your resort on the way (Bathery 6:00 · Kalpetta 6:45 · breakfast at Mananthavady)
9:15 AM — Thirunelli Temple: The 'Kashi of the south' in the Brahmagiri forest, and the walk to the Papanasini stream. (Temple dress code applies)
11:30 AM — Kuruva Island: Raft across to river islands of bamboo and old trees on the Kabani. Lunch after, own expense. (Daily cap · entry own expense)
3:00 PM — Tholpetty jeep safari: Forest jeep with a guide through the sanctuary — elephants, gaur and deer if you're lucky. (Safari paid direct · seats limited)
7:00 PM — Drop-off: Kalpetta, Sulthan Bathery, or your resort
WYD_NORTH.gtk:
🎟️ Caps & seats: Kuruva admits a fixed number of visitors a day, at the gate, first come. Safari jeeps are limited; if Kuruva or Tholpetty is full we tell you on the spot.
🛕 At Thirunelli: Kerala temple customs apply; the inner temple may be for Hindus only. Men in mundu, no shirts inside; women in saree or churidar.
🌧️ Seasons: Kuruva usually shuts in the monsoon (about June–September) and on heavy-rain days. Forest safaris can pause in summer or on court and forest orders.
👟 Walking: Kuruva means wet rocks and roots — wear shoes that grip. The Papanasini walk at Thirunelli is about 1.5 km return, uneven.
WYD_NORTH.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
WYD_NORTH.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Kuruva entry, raft and safari jeep; Temple offerings; Tolls and parking (private trips)
WYD_NORTH.carry: Shoes that grip on wet rock; Temple-friendly clothes; Hat and water bottle; Cash for entry & safari

WYD_EDAKKAL.desc: Stone Age carvings in a rock cleft high on Ambukuthi hill, the odd skull of Phantom Rock, Wayanad's heritage museum and the old Jain temple of Sulthan Bathery.
WYD_EDAKKAL.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Kalpetta KSRTC bus station · Sulthan Bathery bus station · your resort on the way (Kalpetta 8:00 · Bathery 8:45)
9:15 AM — Edakkal Caves: A steep climb up Ambukuthi hill to rock carvings thousands of years old, and a wide Wayanad view. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
12:00 PM — Phantom Rock: A giant boulder shaped like a skull, on the Ambalavayal side. Lunch after, own expense. (Photo stop)
1:45 PM — Wayanad Heritage Museum: Tribal tools, hero stones and old weapons at Ambalavayal. (Entry own expense)
3:30 PM — Jain Temple, Sulthan Bathery: The granite Jain temple that later served as Tipu Sultan's 'battery' — and gave the town its name. (Footwear off)
5:00 PM — Drop-off: Kalpetta, Sulthan Bathery, or your resort
WYD_EDAKKAL.gtk:
🗓️ Closing days: Edakkal Caves are closed on Mondays — this tour runs Tuesday to Sunday. Entry is capped and timed; on busy days we may queue at the counter.
🧗 The climb: About 1 km uphill with steep steps and iron ladders near the top. Not for knee or heart trouble — you can wait at the base café.
👟 What to wear: Shoes with grip, loose clothes; carry water. Cover shoulders and knees at the Jain temple.
🌧️ Rain: Edakkal may close in heavy rain or on red-alert days. We check the evening before and call you if plans change.
WYD_EDAKKAL.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
WYD_EDAKKAL.exc: Lunch; Cave, museum and other entry fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
WYD_EDAKKAL.carry: Shoes with good grip; Water bottle; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for entry fees

WYD_MUTHANGA.desc: An early jeep safari in Muthanga for elephants, gaur and deer, the forest highway to Ponkuzhi, Pulpally's Seetha Devi temple and a forest walk to Chethalayam falls.
WYD_MUTHANGA.itin:
6:00 AM — Pickup: Kalpetta KSRTC bus station · Sulthan Bathery bus station · your resort on the way (Kalpetta 6:00 · Bathery 6:45)
7:15 AM — Muthanga jeep safari: Forest department jeep with a guide through the sanctuary at its best hour. Breakfast after, own expense. (Safari paid direct · seats limited)
10:00 AM — Forest drive to Ponkuzhi: Slow drive on the NH 766 forest stretch to the Ponkuzhi Sri Rama temple, near the Karnataka border. (Watch from the vehicle)
11:15 AM — Pulpally Seetha Devi Temple: The Ramayana temple of Seetha and her sons Lava and Kusha. Lunch in Pulpally, own expense. (Temple dress code applies)
1:30 PM — Chethalayam Falls: A forest walk of about 4 km return to a seasonal waterfall. (Forest entry own expense)
5:00 PM — Drop-off: Kalpetta, Sulthan Bathery, or your resort
WYD_MUTHANGA.gtk:
🐘 The safari: Jeeps and guides are from the forest department; tickets at the counter or online. Seats are limited — we arrive early; sightings are never guaranteed.
🌳 In the forest: No stopping or getting out on the forest highway; animals have right of way. Speak softly; no bright colours, perfume or plastic.
🗓️ Closures: Safaris and the falls can close in fire season, heavy rain or on forest orders. We check the evening before and call you if plans change.
🥾 The walk: Chethalayam is a forest path, slippery when wet; leeches in the rains. Not for knee trouble — wait at the gate if you prefer.
WYD_MUTHANGA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
WYD_MUTHANGA.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Safari jeep, forest and temple fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
WYD_MUTHANGA.carry: Earth-coloured clothes; Walking shoes with grip; Binoculars if you have them; Cash for safari & entry

WYD_CCJ.desc: Flying from Calicut International at Karipur? We pick you up at your home or resort in Wayanad and drive you down the Thamarassery ghat to the terminal — or meet you at arrivals.
WYD_CCJ.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or resort in Kalpetta, Vythiri, Meppadi, Sulthan Bathery or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~95 km via Thamarassery ghat: About 2.5–3 hours down the ghat on NH 766 to Kunnamangalam, then the Kozhikode bypass to Ramanattukara and Karipur.
Drop-off — Calicut International Airport: Departures kerb at Karipur. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
WYD_CCJ.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave about 6 hours before an international flight and 5 hours before a domestic one. Ghat jams on weekends and holidays can add an hour — we plan around them.
⛰️ The ghat: Nine hairpins between Lakkidi and Adivaram; tell us if you get car-sick. On red-alert days the ghat can close — we call you early with a plan.
🧳 Luggage: Gulf flights mean big bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller for families. Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags.
🔁 Landing at Karipur?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
WYD_CCJ.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
WYD_CCJ.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
WYD_CCJ.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Motion-sickness tablets; Water for the drive

WYD_CNN.desc: Flying from Kannur International at Mattannur? We pick you up at your home or resort in Wayanad and drive you down the Periya ghat to the terminal — or meet you at arrivals.
WYD_CNN.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or resort in Kalpetta, Mananthavady, Sulthan Bathery or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~115 km via Periya ghat: About 3–3.5 hours via Mananthavady, the Periya–Nedumpoyil ghat, Kuthuparamba and Mattannur.
Drop-off — Kannur International Airport: Departures kerb at Mattannur. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
WYD_CNN.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave about 6.5 hours before an international flight and 5.5 hours before a domestic one. Mananthavady town and the ghat can be slow — we plan around them.
⛰️ The ghat: The Periya–Nedumpoyil ghat is narrow with sharp bends; tell us if you get car-sick. Landslides or heavy rain can close a ghat — we call you early with a plan.
🧳 Luggage: Gulf flights mean big bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller for families. Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags.
🔁 Landing at Kannur?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
WYD_CNN.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
WYD_CNN.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
WYD_CNN.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Motion-sickness tablets; Water for the drive

WYD_MYSORE.desc: From Wayanad through the Muthanga and Bandipur forests to Mysore: Tipu's Srirangapatna, the Brindavan fountains, Chamundi Hill and the palace of the Wodeyars — your own vehicle and driver.
WYD_MYSORE.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive to Mysore: From your door, resort or Kalpetta / Bathery bus stand — about 140 km through the Muthanga and Bandipur forests, roughly 4.5 hours with breakfast. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · 2:30 PM — Srirangapatna: Tipu Sultan's island town on the Kaveri: the Ranganathaswamy temple, Daria Daulat palace and the Gumbaz. (Entry own expense)
Day 1 · evening — Brindavan Gardens: Terraced gardens and the musical fountain below the KRS dam. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · 7:30 AM — Chamundi Hill: The hilltop temple, the giant Nandi and a view over the city. (Temple dress code)
Day 2 · 10:00 AM — Mysore Palace: The Wodeyars' palace of stained glass, mirrors and carved doors; lunch in town. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · 1:00 PM — Drive home: About 140 km back through Bandipur; at your door in Wayanad by about 5:30 PM.
WYD_MYSORE.gtk:
🐘 Bandipur road: The forest stretch is closed to traffic from 9 PM to 6 AM — we cross in daylight both ways. No stopping or feeding animals inside the forest.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Mysore is in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🏰 Palace & temple: Shoes are removed inside the palace — carry socks. Chamundi temple: modest dress; queues are long on weekends and festival days.
🏨 Your stay: You book one night in Mysore; near the palace is easiest. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
WYD_MYSORE.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Mysore sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
WYD_MYSORE.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Palace, garden and entry fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
WYD_MYSORE.carry: Photo ID; Socks for the palace; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for entry fees

WYD_COORG.desc: From Wayanad through the Tholpetty forest into Karnataka's coffee country: misty Madikeri, Abbey Falls, Dubare's elephants and the Tibetan Golden Temple — your own vehicle and driver.
WYD_COORG.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive to Coorg: From your door, resort or Kalpetta bus stand — about 145 km via Mananthavady, the Tholpetty forest and Gonikoppal, roughly 4.5 hours with breakfast. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · 2:00 PM — Abbey Falls: A short walk down through coffee and spice estates to the falls near Madikeri. (Entry own expense · no bathing)
Day 1 · sunset — Raja's Seat: The Kodava kings' garden lookout over layers of misty hills. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · 8:30 AM — Dubare Elephant Camp: Watch the camp elephants bathe and feed by the Kaveri — reached by boat. (Mornings only · paid direct)
Day 2 · 11:00 AM — Golden Temple, Bylakuppe: The great Namdroling monastery in the Tibetan settlement; Tibetan lunch nearby. (Shoes off · quiet inside)
Day 2 · 1:30 PM — Drive home: About 140 km back via Gonikoppal and Mananthavady; at your door in Wayanad by about 6 PM.
WYD_COORG.gtk:
🐘 Dubare & the seasons: Elephant activities run only in the morning; the boat crossing can stop when the river is high. Falls and hill paths are slippery in the monsoon (June–September).
🌳 Forest roads: The Tholpetty – Kutta road runs through elephant forest — we cross in daylight, no stops. Many bends on the Kodagu estate roads: carry motion sickness tablets.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Coorg is in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🏨 Your stay: You book one night in or near Madikeri — coffee-estate homestays are a Coorg favourite. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
WYD_COORG.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Coorg sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
WYD_COORG.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry, elephant camp and boat fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
WYD_COORG.carry: Light jacket and raincoat; Photo ID; Comfortable walking shoes; Cash for entry fees

WYD_OOTY.desc: From Wayanad through Meppadi's tea country and Gudalur up to the Nilgiris: Pykara falls, Ooty's gardens and lake, and the highest peak in the hills — your vehicle, your pace.
WYD_OOTY.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive to Ooty: From your door, resort or Kalpetta bus stand — about 125 km via Meppadi, Gudalur and the Naduvattam ghat, roughly 5 hours with breakfast. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · 10:15 AM — Pykara Falls & Lake: Falls and a boat lake on the Gudalur–Ooty road, 20 km before town. (Entry & boating paid direct)
Day 1 · afternoon — Botanical Garden & Ooty Lake: Ooty's 1840s gardens, then a walk or a boat on the lake. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · 8:00 AM — Doddabetta Peak & tea factory: The highest point in the Nilgiris, then a working tea factory on the way down. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · 11:30 AM — Drive home: About 125 km back via Gudalur; lunch on the way, at your door in Wayanad by about 4:30 PM.
WYD_OOTY.gtk:
🎫 Nilgiris e-pass: Every vehicle entering the Nilgiris needs a Tamil Nadu e-pass — we apply for it. Single-use plastic is banned: carry refillable steel bottles.
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Ooty is in Tamil Nadu: interstate permit, border tax and green fee are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🐘 Hill roads: Elephants roam the Gudalur side — we drive in daylight and never stop in the forest. Naduvattam ghat has many bends: carry motion sickness tablets.
🧥 Weather: Cold nights all year — bring warm clothes. Clouds often hide Doddabetta's view by late morning, so we go early.
WYD_OOTY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Ooty and Pykara sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
WYD_OOTY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry and boating fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
WYD_OOTY.carry: Warm jacket; Photo ID; Refillable water bottle; Cash for entry fees

WYD_KOZHIKODE.desc: Down the Thamarassery ghat to the old spice coast: Beypore's wooden-dhow yards, halwa on SM Street, Kappad where Vasco da Gama landed and an evening on Kozhikode beach.
WYD_KOZHIKODE.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: From your door, resort or Kalpetta bus stand; down the Thamarassery ghat, breakfast on the way.
9:45 AM — Beypore: The uru (wooden dhow) yards on the Chaliyar river, then a walk on the long pulimuttu breakwater. (Working yards · ask before photos)
11:45 AM — Mananchira & SM Street: The town square, then Mittai Theruvu for halwa and banana chips. Lunch in town, own expense. (Street is walk-only)
2:30 PM — Kappad Beach: The quiet beach and memorial stone where Vasco da Gama landed in 1498. (No swimming in rough sea)
4:15 PM — Kozhikode Beach: The promenade, old sea piers and lighthouse; street snacks before the drive home.
8:00 PM — Drop-off: Back up the ghat to your door or resort in Wayanad.
WYD_KOZHIKODE.gtk:
⛰️ Thamarassery ghat: Nine hairpins each way — it jams on weekends and holidays, so we start early. Carry motion sickness tablets if anyone needs them.
🏖️ Beaches: Swim only where lifeguards allow; no sea bathing in the monsoon (June–September). Kozhikode beach is busiest at sunset — keep children close.
⛵ Beypore yards: The uru yards are working boatyards — watch from the side and ask before photos. Work and visits can pause on Sundays and holidays.
🍛 Eat like a local: Kozhikode biryani, Malabar snacks and halwa are the city's pride — lunch and snacks own expense. Many SM Street shops close on Sundays.
WYD_KOZHIKODE.inc: Private vehicle and driver; No waiting charges; Driver bata; Pickup in Kalpetta or Bathery
WYD_KOZHIKODE.exc: Meals and snacks; Any entry or camera fees; Tolls and parking
WYD_KOZHIKODE.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Comfortable walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for halwa & street food

WYD_CHIKMAGALUR.desc: Through Bandipur and Mysore to the Hoysala temples of Belur and Halebidu, then Karnataka's highest peak, the shrine where India's coffee began and a hill-lake sunset — your own vehicle and driver.
WYD_CHIKMAGALUR.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & the long drive: From your door, resort or Kalpetta / Bathery bus stand — through Bandipur, Mysore and Hassan, about 330 km and 11 hours with stops. (Stays booked by you)
Day 1 · afternoon — Halebidu & Belur: The UNESCO-listed Hoysala temples: carved stone friezes, bracket figures and the Chennakeshava temple. (Shoes off · guide paid direct)
Day 2 · 7:00 AM — Mullayanagiri: Karnataka's highest peak: a misty ridge road, then steps to the summit shrine. (Vehicle slots may apply)
Day 2 · late morning — Baba Budangiri & Manikyadhara: The hill shrine where coffee first came to India, and a small falls nearby. (Modest dress)
Day 2 · evening — Hirekolale Lake: A quiet reservoir ringed by hills — the classic Chikmagalur sunset.
Day 3 · 7:00 AM — Drive home: About 320 km via Hassan, Mysore and Bandipur; at your door in Wayanad by about 5 PM.
WYD_CHIKMAGALUR.gtk:
⛰️ Mullayanagiri rules: Uphill traffic may run in time slots with online pre-booking; big vehicles can be stopped lower down — we check before you go. Closed on red-alert days and around shrine festivals (Datta Jayanti in December).
🛕 Hoysala temples: Shoes off and modest dress; hire an approved guide at the gate for the stories in the stone. Belur is still a living temple — follow the pooja-time rules.
🪪 Karnataka entry: Interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. Bandipur road is closed 9 PM – 6 AM, so we leave at 6 AM and cross home in daylight.
🏨 Your stays: You book two nights in or near Chikmagalur — coffee-estate homestays are a favourite. Your driver's night allowances are in our price.
WYD_CHIKMAGALUR.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; All Chikmagalur sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
WYD_CHIKMAGALUR.exc: Your hotels; Meals; Entry, guide and jeep fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
WYD_CHIKMAGALUR.carry: Light jacket and raincoat; Photo ID; Socks for the temples; Cash for entry fees

WYD_VELANKANNI.desc: From Wayanad down the churam to the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health at Velankanni — Mass, Our Lady's Tank, the Way of the Cross and Morning Star Church, at an easy pace.
WYD_VELANKANNI.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup: Kalpetta KSRTC bus station · Sulthan Bathery bus station · your resort on the way
Day 1 · 4:45 PM — Over the churam to Karur: Down the Thamarassery churam at first light, then via Palakkad and Coimbatore. (Room booked by you)
Day 2 · 11:00 AM — Velankanni Basilica: Check in, then the shrine of Our Lady of Good Health and Our Lady's Tank. (Modest dress)
Day 2 · evening — Rosary & the beach: Evening rosary and candle prayers at the shrine; a walk on the beach. (No sea bathing)
Day 3 · morning — Mass & the Way of the Cross: Morning Mass, Our Lady's path, Morning Star Church and the museum. (Malayalam Mass — re-confirm)
Day 3 · 1:30 PM — Drive to Karur: Back via Thanjavur and Trichy; night in Karur. (Room booked by you)
Day 4 · 4:00 PM — Drop-off: Kalpetta, Sulthan Bathery, or your resort
WYD_VELANKANNI.gtk:
⛪ At the Basilica: Dress modestly — shoulders and knees covered; footwear off where asked. Masses run all day in several languages, usually one in Malayalam — we re-confirm the time.
🌊 Beach & crowds: The sea at Velankanni is rough and drownings have been reported — no swimming. Keep children close; we fix a meeting point at the Basilica arch.
🕯️ At an easy pace: A full, unhurried day at the shrine — Mass, the Way of the Cross and evening rosary. Buy candles and offerings only at the shrine's own counters.
🛣️ Long drive & rooms: Breaks every 2–3 hours; the churam is driven in daylight only. You book your rooms in Karur and Velankanni; we share a list of pilgrim lodges near the shrine.
WYD_VELANKANNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Driver bata and night allowance; Caretaker for 10+ guests
WYD_VELANKANNI.exc: Your rooms; Meals; Offerings and museum entry; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
WYD_VELANKANNI.carry: Modest clothes for church; Photo ID; Your regular medicines; Cash for offerings and candles
